name: Chess tactical calculation

environment.terminal_success: unique legal first move forcing mate in one, two or three

objective: Improve first-move accuracy on deterministic KQK and KRK positions with unique forced mates in one, two or three under a fixed inference budget.

evaluation.seed_policy: fixed protected generator seeds; candidate receives FEN and legal moves but not labels

fairness: same starting code and experiment budget
same generated positions and legal move lists
parent and candidate use the identical protected verifier
integrity: labels are never passed into the mutable policy
candidate may use chess rules but no external engine, tablebase or network service
suite and verifier hashes are logged
illegal moves and policy exceptions are scored explicitly
